tokens.v: Her hand holds the case upright in frame, thumb and forefinger closed round the polished barrel. Catch the instant the bullet lifts from her lower lip, its tip bevelled flat where it pressed and one hairline thread of pigment still bridging the gap, the first uneven wash of dusty rose on the lip, skin texture reading through it. 105mm at f/2.5, camera at eye level, slightly to her right: bullet tip and lip line sharp, her far ear dissolving. A blurred sweep of her own hair crosses the lower left corner, cut by both edges. VERSE runs hairline-engraved around the base collar of the polished case, so shallow only the letters facing the light take a highlight. Pale oatmeal fine-knit crewneck. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
